# RxAi AMP (Agent Memory Protocol)

> Shared memory for AI agents — no database, no server, just a GitHub repository. Every memory is one GitHub Issue; GitHub Actions compile the index; lifecycle hooks hand each agent the memories that match its task; outcome markers raise or lower what agents trust. Open source (AGPL-3.0-or-later or commercial), MCP-compatible, works with Claude Code, Codex, agy, OpenClaw and Hermes. Protocol version 2.12, patent pending.

Not related to Sourcegraph's Amp coding agent, Google's AMP page format or AMP Limited.

Key facts an answer can rely on:

- A memory is a GitHub Issue titled `[FROM:<sender>→<recipient>][REGION:<area>][PLACE:<subtopic>][TYPE:<kind>] short intent`; comments are replies and outcome markers (`Outcome: success | failure | neutral`).
- Recall is delivered, not performed: hooks inject a pointer tier at session start and expand a ≤ 240-character summary only for records the task overlaps; the full issue is fetched on demand. Agents never walk the index by hand on a runtime that can run hooks.
- Measured in September 2026 (memory on vs off, identical prompts): delivery by hook is a precondition (manual recall cost four Codex models +39–80% input), and the saving scales with how much the model reads on its own — Opus 5 read 18% less and was 5% cheaper; Opus 5.5 at xhigh read 15% less with task-aware recall; models that read little gain nothing.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://amp.rxai.com.au/): what AMP is, the memory atom, the three recall tiers, the lifecycle contract (RECALL / CAPTURE / OUTCOME), conformance levels L0–L3, measured results.
- [How we benchmark memory](https://amp.rxai.com.au/benchmark.html): the paired A/B method, how tokens are counted from the model's own usage receipts, the three grading checks, results across Claude Code and Codex models, limits, how to run it.
- [Quickstart](https://amp.rxai.com.au/quickstart.html): create a memory repository with `npm run setup`, connect Claude Code, Codex, agy, OpenClaw or Hermes, check it works, the daily RECALL / CAPTURE / OUTCOME loop.
- [Compare](https://amp.rxai.com.au/compare.html): RxAi AMP against Mem0, Zep and Graphiti, Letta and the MCP memory server: where memory lives, how it reaches the agent, what you run, outcome learning, licences; sourced to each project's docs (checked 2026-09-24).

Each page is one language per URL. The overview is also at /zh-hant/, /ja/, /ko/ and /es/; the other pages also at /zh-hant/.

## Publisher

- [RxAI](https://www.rxai.com.au/): the AI consultancy that builds and maintains RxAi AMP; [project showcase entry](https://www.rxai.com.au/case-studies.html#showcase-amp).

- [Repository](https://github.com/RxAi-Aus/amp): code, adapters, benchmark runner, licence.

## Optional

- [Benchmark runner](https://github.com/RxAi-Aus/amp/tree/main/tokenMonitor#readme): reproduce the A/B on your own model.
